$comment: THE OUTSIDE CORPUS for the graph-truth runtime limb (scripts/graph-truth-runtime-limb.mjs).
⚠ `provenance` IS A GATE, NOT A LABEL. The runner accepts only `captured` (real user
briefs, taken from live sessions) or `external` (written by someone other than the author
of the code under test). It EXITS 2 on `authored`, which is what this file currently
carries — so the runtime limb cannot report a pass until this corpus is replaced with real
briefs. That refusal is the point, not a gap to route around.
WHY: for any predicate over natural language, a corpus drawn from the author's head cannot
see the class the author did not imagine, and a full pass against one is a perfect score on
the wrong exam. This estate has measured that twice: six live defects shipped in a
stated-value-honour rule under a 25/25 mutant kit, every invariant true as stated and every
defect living in the BREADTH of the predicates.
HOW TO FILL IT (the sequencing that keeps it honest):
1. capture real briefs from staging sessions, or commission them from someone who has not
read the extraction code — NOT from the lane implementing the fix;
2. for each, write `expectations` naming the semantic object, the STATING PHRASE (used to
resolve the object BY IDENTITY via source_quote — never by value), the quantity path,
and each qualifier with the marker that proves it reached the science input AND the
reason_codes that would constitute an HONEST REFUSAL instead;
3. set `provenance` to `captured` or `external` and record where they came from.
The two entries below are SHAPE EXAMPLES under `authored` provenance. They are here to show
the schema and to be replaced. They are deliberately NOT evidence, and the runner will not
let them become evidence.
provenance_note: SHAPE EXAMPLES ONLY — written by the lane that wrote the suite. The runner exits 2 on this value by design.

briefs.text: We are deciding whether to invest in retention. Monthly churn is currently 12 percent and we want to cut it.
The board approved a first-year budget cap of GBP 240,000 and we must not go over it.
